scope.holdout_status: NOT HOLDOUT-VALIDATED: weeks 6-9 were previously examined; weeks 1-5 are development only
scope.target: PBP game_seconds_remaining minus the next non-null-play_type row in the same quarter

models.B_pbp_presnap: Conditional median using only qtr, current clock remaining, down, distance, yardline bucket and offense/defense identity. Current play_type, terminal outcome, next-play outcome and future tracking are excluded from model features.
models.C_tracking_presnap: Same pre-snap PBP context and the 22-player team-level kinematic/alignment aggregates computed from raw tracking frames snap-3 through snap-1. No snap frame, post-snap location, terminal event or carrier-candidate list is used.

fixed_model_spec.tracking_bins: speed <=0.5/1/2/over2 yd/s; acceleration <=2/6/12/over12 yd/s^2; nearest teammate spacing <=2/4/7/over7 yd
fixed_model_spec.feature_selection: fixed before scoring; no weeks 6-9 evaluation or tuning

limitations: This is a same-quarter PBP snap-to-next-play clock delta, not whistle time or wall-clock possession duration.
The trained models are cross-fitted within weeks 1-5. Weeks 6-9 were already examined and are not holdout evidence.
PBP target construction uses later clock stamps only as labels; target play outcomes are not model inputs.
Tracking summary is derived only from the same 22 players' x/y positions at snap-3, snap-2 and snap-1; team roles are not individually assigned.
The matching cohort requires complete 22-player histories at all three strictly pre-snap frames, so its scored denominator is narrower than the retrospective comparison.
